changes.directionalIntent: Start/add-direction changes now share the existing bounded retry policy with stops/reversals; one abandoned attempt per acquired bank, current-view and height protections retained.
changes.rasterDirtyMark: Exact viewport tile-block address; 26 cycles instead of 84 per changed tile.

scenes: opening room with recess and pillars
scope.actors: Dead for isolated input/presentation measurement; not a full active-combat throughput benchmark.
scope.busyOnset: A scene-version increment schedules one same-pose background refresh eight frames before input. This synthetic controlled workload isolates producer-busy onset; it is not an alive-enemy measurement.
scope.input: Diagnostic setup writes legal pose once per trial; subsequent motion comes solely from controller events.
scope.picture: Coherent visible camera metadata at PPUCTRL commit; excludes physical display delay.
scope.framePhase: Candidate boots its first picture one refresh earlier. The same phases and button durations are used; 50 Hz movement cadence therefore starts at slightly different tick phases. Single-refresh differences are not meaningful speed claims.
scope.cpu: Cycle-based render costs exclude measured NMI intervals; averages across moving frames are not exact same-pose CPU comparisons.
scope.safety: No queued or partially uploaded bank was discarded by these tests; root runs separate output/timing/full-route validation.

limitations: Final stopped-picture latency remains substantial. The candidate improves busy onset, not every possible input sequence.
Earlier completion can cross a button edge and change which snapshots finish. Some matched stop/reversal cases regress despite earlier initial response.

One corrected baseline transition run detected an ambient personal-settings-file hash change. Origin unknown; test used its frozen portable stock-NTSC settings. Personal settings were not restored or modified.
The initial exploratory baseline/ capture is superseded by baseline-transitions and excluded from these numbers.

linkedInput.scope: Linked 6502 execution with synthetic NMI-owned mutations and seeded camera poses. Pixel preservation compares a retried frame with a clean linked render of the same snapshot, not an independent geometric oracle. No input-device latency, PPU deadline, controller-only route or physical-console claim.

raster.scope: Interrupt-free linked6502 fixtures with injected legal camera state. Every viewport tile and tile ID are checked; complete world/actor/OAM/palette staging and dirty upload lists match baseline at diagnostic poses. Not a controller/PPU timing or gameplay FPS test.

jsnes.scope: Pinned stock JSNES core. Controller-only guide selection, launch, shoot, pause/resume, natural death retry, full accepted completion route and level restart; final public CPU reset interrupt API verifies cold default ON. Read-only CPU write observer; no game or emulator state injection. CPU timing/PPU deadline conclusions require the separate Mesen checks.

mesen.scope: Controller-only actual ROM in stock NTSC Mesen, zero extra scanlines, independent unfiltered geometry oracle; not a physical-console test.

confirmationNote: First full-route capture completed and passed the same gameplay/image checks, but its final ambient personal-settings hash guard failed. This separate confirmation run completed through the guard. Earlier evidence remains under analysis/latency-tuning/full-route; no personal settings were restored or overwritten.
